ecology.name: DELAYED_EXTERNAL_BIT
ecology.store_action: write input bit to external mark
ecology.distractor: make current observation and internal state equal across both histories

boundary.observation_map: STORE sees input; DISTRACT sees unit; QUERY may read W only in the extended arm
boundary.action_map: STORE may write W; other phases do not write
boundary.world_transition: W'=input on STORE and W'=W otherwise

predictions.minimality: environment bit is necessary relative to the frozen zero-internal-bit boundary
predictions.parent_disposition: absorbed exactly by one-bit D2 memory / joint D6 state under matched storage and access

falsifier: any exact replay that violates a numerical prediction, or any zero-bit agent-only carrier that distinguishes the two query histories without reading external state
